question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'ability'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **talent - **natural aptitude or skill.
 
• **aptitude - **a natural ability to do something.
 
• **ability - **possession of the means or skill to do something.
 
• **skill - **expertise 
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe the illness fighting inherent characteristics of bees that get increased by honey components. 
 
• This makes option 3 or ability the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - It should come as no surprise that bees know a lot about honey. They aren't only honey producers; (1) they are also consumers, and pretty sophisticated ones at that. Offer a sick bee (2) different varieties of honey, for example, and it will choose the one that (3) best fights off its infection. Components in honey can help bees live longer, (4) boost their tolerance of harsh conditions such as intense cold and increase their (5) **ability **to fight off infections and heal wounds.*
